text: The account holder Fahad Mirza holds account PK**ABPA****6924 which was opened on 4 February 2023. The subject is a Medical sales officer (salaried) with a declared monthly income of PKR 120,000 per month. Between 4 May 2026 and 29 May 2026 the account received 13 credits totalling PKR 20,109,000 and made 5 debits totalling PKR 16,861,000. There were 12 cash deposits totalling PKR 19,989,000 made at 4 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch). An alert was raised by Tazama on 29 May 2026 after the typology score of 320 exceeded the threshold of 300. Ten of the 12 cash deposits (83%) were between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999, totalling PKR 18,211,000, which is just below the reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000. The cash deposits were made across four different branches, indicating a spread of activity. There was more than one cash deposit on 14 May 2026, suggesting a concentration of activity on a single day. The credits in the activity window were 167.6 times the declared monthly income of PKR 120,000 per month, indicating a volume inconsistent with the declared income. These patterns are consistent with suspected structuring activity. PKR 8,565,000 was sent to Crescent Imports (PK**CRES****1592, Synthetic Bank C) in 2 transactions. PKR 4,952,000 was sent to Al-Noor Exchange Company (PK**AL-N****1888, Synthetic Bank C) in 1 transaction. PKR 3,344,000 was sent to Sheraz Traders (PK**SHER****1518, Synthetic Bank B) in 2 transactions. Debits equal to 84% of credits were paid out with a median of 26.1 hours between the latest credit and each debit. No match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media screening was found on 30 May 2026. Account placed under enhanced monitoring pending the reporting decision; no contact was made with the customer about this review.
